gate.basis: Recorded engineering acceptance agreement: 4 ms physics step, 12 ms maximum. The 12.5 ms rotor time constant is context, not proof of policy delay tolerance or stability.

definitions.motor_rms: RMS over [change, change+0.5 s) (1 ms zero-order hold) and four motors of run minus the in-batch same-condition baseline mean curve; baseline runs use the leave-one-out mean
definitions.gru_distance: Euclidean distance between the committed GRU state at the given offset after the change and the in-batch RAPTOR baseline mean at the same offset
definitions.elimination_ratio: (control - treatment) / (control - baseline) of group means; control N0 (C->N) or C0 (N->C)

scope: One frozen candidate, headless SITL only. Repeats share seed and configuration; exploratory budget, not a statistical test.
